rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE programs approved for pharmacy technicians (ACPE-T) or Board-approved technician courses in CE Broker; pharmacist-approved courses do not count; medication errors and HIV/AIDS courses must be Board approved
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal under 12 months after registration: only 1 h HIV/AIDS and 2 h medication errors. 12 months or more: 9 general hours plus 1 h HIV/AIDS and 2 h medication errors.

topics.who: Board-approved course incl. Florida HIV/AIDS law
Technicians who keep an immunization certification: Board-approved vaccine administration hours, in addition

rules.notes: 18 general + 2 medication errors. Technicians who keep an immunization certification need 2 more Board-approved hours on vaccine administration. Up to 5 h for attending an 8-hour Board meeting. Current registrations expire Dec 31, 2026.
